description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-tasks-client/tests/task_notification_tests.rs with 6 async wiremock tests. Key invariant: TaskNotification/set is destroy-only — client must NEVER send create or update. Oracle: draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 §5.4 (destroy-only MUST), §5.5.1 (filter), §5.5.2 (created sort MUST).

**Tests:**
1. task_notification_get_round_trip: assert resp.list[0].id=="notif1", notification_type==NotificationType::Created, task_id=="task1".
2. task_notification_changes_round_trip: assert resp.destroyed==["notif-old"]; assert no maxChanges in request when None passed.
3. task_notification_set_destroy_only_wire_format: call set(["notif1","notif2"]); assert resp.destroyed==["notif1","notif2"]; assert request has destroy==["notif1","notif2"] and NO create key and NO update key. Oracle: §5.4 destroy-only MUST.
4. task_notification_set_empty_destroy_succeeds: call set([]); assert destroy:[] in request; assert no create/update.
5. task_notification_query_with_filter: pass filter {"type":"created","taskIds":["task1"]}, sort [{"property":"created"}]; assert filter.type=="created" and sort[0].property=="created" in request. Oracle: §5.5.1 filter fields, §5.5.2 created MUST.
6. task_notification_query_changes_round_trip: assert request has sinceQueryState=="qs1" and maxChanges==20.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 6 tests pass. Destroy-only invariant (no create/update) explicitly asserted.
title: Wiremock tests: TaskNotification/get /changes /set /query /queryChanges
